title: PR #15: feat: enforce 360 million ATC L1 supply cap
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Summary

Makes the A-TownChain L1 native coin economics consensus-visible in the executable state machine.

### Implemented
- canonical native coin symbol: ATC
- maximum lifetime L1 supply: 360,000,000 ATC
- genesis-only allocation API with checked supply cap
- genesis allocation sealing
- supply included in deterministic L1 state root
- restart path seals genesis allocations
- regression tests for cap, sealing, and state-root commitment
- canonical economics documentation

### Boundary
This PR defines the maximum supply only. It does not invent a genesis allocation schedule or distribute ATC to treasury, validators, founders, or other parties.

### Security invariant
No post-genesis mint operation exists in the canonical L1 state machine.
